Name: Amnesia
Author: Belim
Description: The opposite of Recall. Nothing photographs your screen, reads what is on it, or keeps a list of what you opened, and what you type into Start stays on the PC. Costs you Timeline, online dictation, Bing answers in Start and the assistants in Edge and Notepad.

Name: Less preinstalled
Author: Belim
Description: Remove the preinstalled apps nobody asked for, from Solitaire to TikTok.

Name: Less advertising
Author: Belim
Description: Reduce suggestions and promotions in Windows.

Name: Familiar Explorer
Author: Belim
Description: Show file extensions, open This PC and use classic context menus.

Name: Quieter taskbar
Author: Belim
Description: Left alignment, no search box and no Copilot taskbar button.
